_readme: CLEARLY-FAKE demo news. NOT real reporting. is_demo=true on every record. Exists only to demonstrate tagging, location matching, sentiment and event clustering offline, because this sandbox blocks live RSS/JSON feeds. Two records intentionally describe the SAME demo event from two 'sources' so clustering -> status=confirmed can be shown. Real feeds replace these when allow_network=true.
